mapper.sql: WITH RECURSIVE products AS (SELECT product_id AS id FROM kb_publication_product WHERE publication_id=#{query.publicationId}), questions AS (SELECT DISTINCT q.question_id AS id FROM kb_publication_question q JOIN kb_publication_product p ON p.id=q.publication_product_id WHERE p.publication_id=#{query.publicationId}), sources AS (SELECT source_id AS id FROM kb_publication_reference_source WHERE publication_id=#{query.publicationId} UNION SELECT r.source_id FROM kb_product_reference_source r JOIN products p ON p.id=r.product_id UNION SELECT q.source_id FROM kb_question_source q JOIN questions l ON l.id=q.question_id UNION SELECT id FROM kb_source WHERE id IN #{x}), points AS (SELECT k.kp_id AS id FROM kb_question_kp k JOIN questions q ON q.id=k.question_id UNION SELECT k.kp_id FROM kb_product_kp k JOIN products p ON p.id=k.product_id UNION SELECT k.kp_id FROM kb_source_kp k JOIN sources s ON s.id=k.source_id), outlines AS (SELECT k.outline_id AS id FROM kb_kp_outline k JOIN points p ON p.id=k.kp_id UNION SELECT o.outline_id FROM kb_product_outline_scope o JOIN products p ON p.id=o.product_id UNION SELECT o.outline_id FROM kb_source_outline_scope o JOIN sources s ON s.id=o.source_id)

SELECT p.id,'PRODUCT' AS objectType,p.title AS name,p.row_version AS rowVersion,NULL AS questionType,NULL AS stemHtml,NULL AS answerHtml,p.asset_id AS assetId,'PRODUCT' AS relationKind, pr.subject AS subject,NULL AS sourceKind,NULL AS textbookVersion,NULL AS grade,NULL AS term,NULL AS edition FROM kb_product p JOIN products x ON x.id=p.id LEFT JOIN kb_product_profile pr ON pr.product_id=p.id UNION ALL SELECT q.id,'QUESTION',q.title,q.row_version,q.question_type,q.stem_html,q.answer_html,NULL,'PRODUCT_QUESTION',q.subject,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL FROM kb_question q JOIN questions x ON x.id=q.id UNION ALL SELECT s.id,'SOURCE',s.title,s.row_version,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,'REFERENCE_OR_SOURCE',pr.subject,s.source_kind,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL FROM kb_source s JOIN sources x ON x.id=s.id LEFT JOIN kb_source_profile pr ON pr.source_id=s.id UNION ALL SELECT k.id,'KP',k.name,k.row_version,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,'KNOWLEDGE_POINT',k.subject,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL FROM kb_kp k JOIN points x ON x.id=k.id UNION ALL SELECT o.id,'OUTLINE',o.title,o.row_version,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,'TEXTBOOK_OUTLINE',o.subject,NULL,o.textbook_version,o.grade,o.term,o.edition FROM kb_outline o JOIN outlines x ON x.id=o.id
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM () r WHERE objectType=#{query.objectType} AND id=#{query.objectId} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{query.pageSize} OFFSET #{query.offset}
SELECT id,objectType,name,rowVersion FROM () r ORDER BY objectType,id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM () r WHERE objectType=#{query.objectType} AND id=#{query.objectId}

SELECT asset_id FROM kb_publication_image WHERE publication_id=#{query.publicationId} UNION SELECT p.asset_id FROM kb_product p JOIN products x ON x.id=p.id UNION SELECT a.asset_id FROM kb_source_asset a JOIN sources s ON s.id=a.source_id UNION SELECT a.asset_id FROM kb_question_asset a JOIN questions q ON q.id=a.question_id

SELECT fact FROM ( SELECT CONCAT(objectType,':',id,':',rowVersion) AS fact FROM () r WHERE objectType <> 'QUESTION' UNION SELECT CONCAT('NODE:',n.id,':',n.row_version) FROM kb_outline_node n JOIN kb_outline_node_kp nk ON nk.node_id=n.id JOIN points p ON p.id=nk.kp_id UNION SELECT CONCAT('SOURCE_FILE:',s.source_id,':',s.asset_id,':',a.status,':',a.sha256) FROM kb_source_asset s JOIN sources x ON x.id=s.source_id JOIN kb_asset a ON a.asset_id=s.asset_id UNION SELECT CONCAT('SOURCE_PROFILE:',p.source_id,':',p.row_version) FROM kb_source_profile p JOIN sources x ON x.id=p.source_id UNION SELECT CONCAT('PRODUCT_PROFILE:',p.product_id,':',p.row_version) FROM kb_product_profile p JOIN products x ON x.id=p.product_id UNION SELECT CONCAT('SOURCE_KP:',k.source_id,':',k.kp_id) FROM kb_source_kp k JOIN sources x ON x.id=k.source_id UNION SELECT CONCAT('SOURCE_SCOPE:',s.source_id,':',s.outline_id,':',s.row_version,':',COALESCE(n.node_id,0)) FROM kb_source_outline_scope s JOIN sources x ON x.id=s.source_id LEFT JOIN kb_source_outline_scope_node n ON n.scope_id=s.id UNION SELECT CONCAT('PRODUCT_SCOPE:',s.product_id,':',s.outline_id,':',s.row_version,':',COALESCE(n.node_id,0)) FROM kb_product_outline_scope s JOIN products x ON x.id=s.product_id LEFT JOIN kb_product_outline_scope_node n ON n.scope_id=s.id ) facts ORDER BY fact

SELECT 'PRODUCT_QUESTION' AS type,'PRODUCT' AS fromType,CAST(p.product_id AS CHAR) AS fromId,'QUESTION' AS toType,CAST(q.question_id AS CHAR) AS toId FROM kb_publication_product p JOIN kb_publication_question q ON q.publication_product_id=p.id WHERE p.publication_id=#{query.publicationId} UNION SELECT 'PRODUCT_REFERENCE','PRODUCT',CAST(p.product_id AS CHAR),'SOURCE',CAST(p.source_id AS CHAR) FROM kb_product_reference_source p JOIN products x ON x.id=p.product_id UNION SELECT 'QUESTION_SOURCE','QUESTION',CAST(s.question_id AS CHAR),'SOURCE',CAST(s.source_id AS CHAR) FROM kb_question_source s JOIN questions q ON q.id=s.question_id UNION SELECT 'QUESTION_KP','QUESTION',CAST(k.question_id AS CHAR),'KP',CAST(k.kp_id AS CHAR) FROM kb_question_kp k JOIN questions q ON q.id=k.question_id UNION SELECT 'PRODUCT_DECLARED_KP','PRODUCT',CAST(k.product_id AS CHAR),'KP',CAST(k.kp_id AS CHAR) FROM kb_product_kp k JOIN products p ON p.id=k.product_id UNION SELECT 'KP_OUTLINE','KP',CAST(k.kp_id AS CHAR),'OUTLINE',CAST(k.outline_id AS CHAR) FROM kb_kp_outline k JOIN points p ON p.id=k.kp_id ORDER BY type,fromId,toId

SELECT f.objectType,f.objectId,a.asset_id AS assetId,a.original_name AS fileName,a.content_type AS mimeType,a.file_size AS byteSize,f.role FROM ( SELECT 'PRODUCT' AS objectType,p.id AS objectId,p.asset_id AS assetId,'PRODUCT_ORIGINAL' AS role FROM kb_product p JOIN products x ON x.id=p.id UNION SELECT 'SOURCE',s.source_id,s.asset_id,'SOURCE_ORIGINAL' FROM kb_source_asset s JOIN sources x ON x.id=s.source_id UNION SELECT 'QUESTION',q.question_id,q.asset_id,'QUESTION_RESOURCE' FROM kb_question_asset q JOIN questions x ON x.id=q.question_id ) f JOIN kb_asset a ON a.asset_id=f.assetId WHERE f.objectType=#{query.objectType} AND f.objectId IN #{x} ORDER BY f.objectId,a.asset_id

SELECT DISTINCT nk.kp_id AS kpId,n.outline_id AS outlineId,n.id AS nodeId,n.parent_id AS parentId,n.row_version AS rowVersion,n.title,n.sort_order AS sortOrder FROM kb_outline_node n JOIN kb_outline_node_kp nk ON nk.node_id=n.id JOIN points p ON p.id=nk.kp_id JOIN outlines o ON o.id=n.outline_id WHERE nk.kp_idn.outline_id IN #{x} ORDER BY n.outline_id,n.sort_order,n.id,nk.kp_id
